about: One file per project: the rules the project's EIR / BEP set. Put it beside the central model (or in its 'ACE Vault' folder); for cloud (ACC) models map the model in %APPDATA%\ACE-RevitMCP\config.json: "projects": { "<cloud model id>": "<project folder>" }. Every section merges over the office files key by key and the project wins; "inheritOffice": false makes a section replace the office one. 'requirement' links a rule to the requirement record it proves (ACE Vault\requirements.json).

naming._about: Optional. pattern: a regex every user workset name must match; allowed: when not empty, the only names allowed; rename: explicit old -> new names. Shared Levels and Grids is exempt. Read by assign_worksets action audit / rename.
